verdict.rationale: Government digital services can plausibly publish their source code under an open license, so this axis applies to CRA's online services. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions source code, repositories, or any open license. The pack covers only service descriptions (business registration, EFILE, e-services) and an llms.txt probe that is unrelated to source openness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
